_: Broly's crater (optional, built only when roms/buu.gba is present): Buu's Fury's walled wasteland crater (variation record 0x0822229C in that ROM; its map table is not decoded, so the record is named by address), imported whole: all four layers and the collision, its tiles converted to LoG2's palette (nearest colour) into new tile banks. The LoG2-only arena is zone 15 area 3.
name: broly_crater
